verdicts.reason: Both break the core concept the same way: the quote is pulled out of the framed illustration and set as a 1–2 word-per-line column (orphaned 'JUST', 'WEAR'), while the frame is shrunk to a small thumbnail that now shows a stray 'BEAUTY ILLUSTRATION' placeholder. The attribution 'CAROLYN MURPHY' sits under the image instead of under the quote, splitting the group. B sets the quote slightly larger, so it fills the left column a bit better, but that does not fix the shared structural flaws, so the two are effectively equivalent.
